sloka: निक्षिप्य परमायत्तो निकुम्भं निष्पिपेष ह।उत्पत्य चास्य वेगेन पपातोरसि वीर्यवान् ।। ६.७७.२२ ।।
transliteration: nikṣipya paramāyatto nikumbhaṁ niṣpipeṣa ha।utpatya cāsya vegena papātorasi vīryavān ।। 6.77.22 ।।

translations.english: Taking hold of the neck with both arms and twisting it round Hanuman broke off the neck of Nikumbha while he was crying terribly.
